town_square.name: Town Square
town_square.description: You are standing in the center of a small training town. A stone fountain bubbles here. Paths lead in every direction.

north_road.name: North Road
north_road.description: A dusty road leads north toward the wilds. The town square is south.

goblin_path.name: Goblin Path
goblin_path.description: A narrow path with claw marks in the dirt.

training_yard.name: Training Yard
training_yard.description: Wooden dummies and practice blades are lined up here.

south_gate.name: South Gate
south_gate.description: The old town gate stands open. Guards nod as you pass.

market.name: Market
market.description: Small stalls sell food, torches, and worn adventuring gear.

temple_steps.name: Temple Steps
temple_steps.description: White stone steps rise toward a quiet temple. Incense drifts through the air.

old_well.name: Old Well
old_well.description: A mossy well sits in a shaded corner of town. The rope creaks softly.

guard_post.name: Guard Post
guard_post.description: Town guards keep watch here. A rack of practice armor sits nearby.

quiet_alley.name: Quiet Alley
quiet_alley.description: A narrow alley runs behind the market stalls.
